compiler_requirement: MoonBit 0.10.20 or newer: the source uses that release's #derive syntax, which 0.10.18 rejects. 0.10.18 and 0.10.14 results are historical
runtime_dependencies: MoonBit core included with SDK; Node built-ins; no registry install required
ci_note: CI installs this pinned, isolated SDK; fresh-clone.yml additionally runs the latest official release on every push and weekly. Historical release CI records remain bound to their original commits.
hash_basis: bytes downloaded from the official host on 2026-11-11; not claimed separately vendor-signed checksums
